title: A bend pasted from the web UI, with a typo

setup.prompt: portrait of an old fisherman, analog photo

why: A given bend as JSON: read it, say what it does, settle the error and the out-of-range amount, then render exactly that bend in place of the run's own bends.

artist.who: Kenji, a tinkerer who has been playing in the Model-Bending web UI. His last run there is in ComfyUI's history.
artist.wants: The bend he copied, as a normal workflow he can keep.
rules: If asked about the misspelled word: yes, multiply.
If told that 3 is outside the usual range: keep it at 3, that's what I had.
You do not pick on boards here; you react to the pictures in a sentence.
Then ask: ok, can I have it as a workflow?
artist.ends_when: the assistant has given you the workflow or told you how to get it.

first_message: I copied this from the bending web UI, can you make it into a proper workflow? {"bends": [{"path": "middle_block.1", "module_type": "rotate", "module_args": {"angle_degrees": 90}, "t": [1.0, 0.7]}, {"path": "input_blocks.4", "module_type": "multipy", "module_args": {"scalar": 3}}]}
expected: Reads the pasted JSON with check_bends instead of guessing at it, and says in plain words what the usable bend does (the model's core, turned, early in the painting)
Raises the bend the node would refuse (module_type "multipy"), suggests multiply, and waits for his answer: no silent fix or drop, and no render before it is settled
Says that 3 on that stage is outside the range that usually keeps a picture together; keeps his amount only because he asks (clamp none) and says it may fall apart
Reads his last run (inspect_run), notices that it is already bent, and uses replace_bends so the pasted bends stand in for the run's own
Renders the same run without bends as the original to compare with, and shows both with one line on what changed
Renders exactly the given bends: no extra candidates and no search around them unless he asks
Offers it as a workflow: propose_workflow when a copy can be opened, otherwise where to add the Apply Bends from JSON box by hand
watch_for: Is the plain-words summary of the JSON correct?
Does the bent picture look like 3× was applied?
